resources.string: Couldn’t read this answer aloud. Check your connection and Google Cloud setup.
Hello, I’m Genie. This is my British voice, powered by Google Chirp 3 HD.
Chirp 3 HD reads answers using Google Cloud. Answer text is sent to Google to generate speech. Internet access and your own billing-enabled Google Cloud project are required.
Add your Google Cloud API key in Genie settings to hear answers.
Google rejected speech setup. Check the API key, voice, API access, and billing in Google Cloud.
Google’s speech quota is unavailable. Check the quota in Google Cloud.
Monthly Genie speech limit reached. Answers are still available as text.

Estimated requests from this device, including interrupted attempts. Offline previews use no characters. Resets each UTC month and stops at 900,000. Other Google Cloud usage and reinstalling can affect totals.
Paste your Google Cloud API key

Create a Google Cloud project, enable billing and the Cloud Text-to-Speech API, then create an API key restricted to that API. Paste it here. Genie encrypts it on this device. This is separate from ChatGPT sign-in.
Key saved. Ask Genie a question to check spoken answers.
Couldn’t save the key securely. Try again.
A little help, one press away.
Enable the Space shortcut, then open any app in the emulator and press your Mac’s spacebar.
In Accessibility settings, select Genie Space shortcut and turn it on. Click inside the emulator before pressing Space.
While enabled, Space opens or closes Genie instead of typing a space. Turn the service off in Accessibility settings to type normally.

Android turns your voice into text. After you connect ChatGPT, Genie sends the final transcript and follow-up context to OpenAI using your ChatGPT plan. Genie does not read the screen or access your existing ChatGPT chats or memory.
Use Space to open or close Genie above any app. This emulator shortcut intercepts the Space key but does not read screen content. Turn it off here to restore normal Space typing.
Allow microphone access to start listening.
No Android speech service is available. Install or enable one in Android settings.
Didn’t catch that. Try speaking again.
Speech recognition couldn’t connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
Couldn’t access the microphone. Check Android’s microphone controls and try again.
The speech service is busy. Try again in a moment.
Speech recognition isn’t ready for this language. Check Android’s speech settings.
Asking Android to download speech support…
Android has scheduled a speech model download. Try again when it’s ready.
Speech recognition couldn’t finish. Try again.
Connect ChatGPT to answer your question.
Sign out of the active account
Complete sign-in and approve ChatGPT plan usage in your browser, then select Return to Genie.
Install or enable a browser to continue with ChatGPT.
Eligible Genie requests use your ChatGPT plan’s allowance. You can manage Genie’s usage and access in ChatGPT settings. Your existing ChatGPT chats and memory stay separate.
You’re signed out on this device. Remote sign-out couldn’t be confirmed. You can disconnect Genie in ChatGPT settings.
Sign-in or ChatGPT plan access was declined. You can try again.
Couldn’t complete ChatGPT sign-in. Check your connection and account eligibility, then try again.
ChatGPT plan usage isn’t enabled for this connection. Sign in and approve plan access.
No compatible model is available for this ChatGPT account.
ChatGPT usage is unavailable or a limit was reached. Review your plan and Genie’s limit in ChatGPT settings.
ChatGPT couldn’t answer this request. Try again.
Couldn’t connect to ChatGPT. Check your internet connection and try again.
The answer didn’t finish. Any text shown is incomplete. Try again.
ChatGPT plan usage isn’t available for this account or workspace. You can choose another eligible account.
ChatGPT couldn’t check usage availability. Please try again later.
This account or model doesn’t support the requested capability.
Loading models for this ChatGPT account…
Lower reasoning is faster and usually uses less allowance. Choices are saved for this account and apply to your next question.
Your saved model is no longer available. Choose another model in settings.
Your saved reasoning level is no longer available for this model. Choose another level in settings.
